project_reference.core_research_question: Reactor-CEvNS, cosmic-muon, and environmental-gamma Compton spectra in reconstructed energy for a 4"×4"×2mm single-sided Ge wafer read out by QPDs (Ta→Al and Al→Hf designs).
project_reference.current_focus: Phase 1 complete ✓ — next: Phase 2 (Reactor Flux Model) and Phase 4 (Muon & Compton) can start

scope.question: What are the reactor-CEvNS, cosmic-ray-muon, and environmental-gamma Compton differential rate spectra in reconstructed energy for a 4 inch x 4 inch x 2 mm single-sided Ge wafer read out by QPDs with Ta->Al and Al->Hf trapping designs?
in_scope: Reactor CEvNS differential rate spectrum in reconstructed energy for a 3 GWth commercial reactor at 25 m standoff with a 4-isotope Huber-Mueller-like antineutrino spectrum plus an explicit sub-1.8 MeV treatment

Cosmic-ray muon energy-deposit spectrum in reconstructed energy for the thin wafer, including chord-length geometry (short vertical crossings and long near-horizontal chords) and Landau-Vavilov straggling
Compton-scattering electron-recoil spectrum in reconstructed energy from a representative environmental radiogenic gamma background (U/Th chains plus K-40 lines and continuum) in the thin wafer

Detector response model: deposited energy to ~50% signal efficiency, trapped quasiparticle number, EMG-profiled tunneling burst, 50 kHz bandwidth-limited reconstruction with perfect tunneling identification
Both trapping designs: Ta absorber to Al trap/junction and Al absorber to Hf trap/junction
Detector geometry: 4 inch x 4 inch x 2 mm Ge wafer (about 110 g), single instrumented face with QPD sensor density of 1 per mm^2 (about 10300 sensors)
out_of_scope: G4CMP phonon-transport simulation (deferred to a later stage)
Imperfect quasiparticle-tunneling identification and readout-noise modeling
Neutron-induced nuclear-recoil backgrounds and other backgrounds beyond cosmic-ray muons and environmental-gamma Compton scattering
unresolved_questions: How should reconstruction behave in the saturated regime: simple Nyquist rate-clip or a dead-time model (paralyzable vs non-paralyzable)?
How should the Ta->Al device tunneling parameters be mapped from the QPD paper's tabulated Al- and Hf-junction devices?
What absolute environmental gamma flux and line composition best represent a surface-level reactor-site deployment?

known_good_baselines: J. Billard et al., J. Phys. G 44, 105101 (2017), arXiv:1612.09035 (Ge CEvNS reactor rate predictions, Table 1: 0.76/0.51/0.26 counts/kg/day above 50/100/200 eV_nr)
CONUS+ Collaboration, Nature 643, 1229 (2025), arXiv:2501.05206 (observed reactor CEvNS on Ge at 3.6 GWth, 20.7 m)
context_gaps: Ta->Al device tunneling parameters (K, Gamma_out, tau_qp) not tabulated in the QPD paper
Absolute environmental gamma flux normalization for the Compton channel not yet fixed
crucial_inputs: 100% phonon collection with ~50% overall deposited-energy-to-signal efficiency
50 kHz signal bandwidth: tunneling faster than the ~25 kHz Nyquist rate is unresolvable
Perfect identification of quasiparticle tunneling events
4 inch x 4 inch x 2 mm single-sided Ge wafer, about 110 g
QPD sensor density of 1 per mm^2 on one face, about 10300 sensors
Commercial 3 GWth reactor at 25 m standoff
Sea-level muon flux with no overburden
Representative environmental radiogenic gamma background for the Compton channel
Exponentially-modified-Gaussian pulse template from the qpd repo
Unified phonon energy scale with no ionization quenching for nuclear and electron recoils

formulations: Freedman CEvNS differential cross section with Helm form factor on natural Ge folded with a 4-isotope reactor antineutrino spectrum
Klein-Nishina Compton scattering of a representative environmental gamma spectrum, thin-target single-scatter dominated, on Ge
Analytic and Monte-Carlo response chain from deposited energy to bandwidth-limited reconstructed energy using the QPD paper pulse model and the qpd-repo EMG template
allowed_estimator_families: Direct spectrum folding and Monte-Carlo sampling of the response chain
allowed_fit_families: EMG pulse-template fits for energy reconstruction
stop_and_rethink_conditions: The CEvNS reconstructed spectrum falls entirely below the effective threshold for both designs
Muon-induced or gamma-induced pileup at sea level makes quiescent reconstruction impossible at 50 kHz bandwidth

claims.statement: The reactor CEvNS spectrum in reconstructed energy is computed for both trapping designs and its total rate agrees with published Ge reactor predictions within a factor of about 2

The sea-level muon spectrum in reconstructed energy is computed for both designs with the chord-length geometry and bandwidth-saturation regime made explicit, and the integral muon rate matches the PDG sea-level flux through the wafer

The Compton electron-recoil spectrum from a representative environmental radiogenic gamma background is computed in reconstructed energy for the wafer, showing Compton continua and edges on the unified phonon energy scale
The reconstructed-versus-deposited energy response, including saturation from the 25 kHz maximum resolvable tunneling rate, is derived for both trapping designs

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-cevns
acceptance_tests.procedure: Reproduce Billard et al. (2017) Table 1 Ge rates under their assumptions, then rescale to 3 GWth at 25 m and compare
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Billard Table 1 reproduced within about 20 percent and rescaled rate consistent within a factor of 2

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-muon
acceptance_tests.procedure: Integrate the muon event rate through the wafer and compare with the PDG sea-level flux times the wafer geometric acceptance

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-compton
acceptance_tests.procedure: Check that Compton edges appear at the Klein-Nishina energies E_edge = 2 E_gamma^2 / (m_e c^2 + 2 E_gamma) for the assumed gamma lines and that the total interaction rate matches the assumed flux times the Ge Compton cross section over the wafer
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Compton edges at predicted energies and interaction rate within a factor of about 2 of the flux-times-cross-section estimate

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-response
acceptance_tests.procedure: Check the low-energy limit (reconstructed energy equals 0.5 times deposited energy within statistical scatter) and the high-energy limit (response saturates once the tunneling rate exceeds 25 kHz)
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Both limiting behaviors reproduced by the pipeline

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-cevns
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Reporting spectra in deposited energy only without the reconstruction and bandwidth model
forbidden_proxies.reason: The decisive output is the spectrum in reconstructed energy

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-muon
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Muon spectrum computed without the 50 kHz bandwidth saturation model or without chord-length geometry
forbidden_proxies.reason: Saturation and thin-wafer geometry shape the muon response and omitting them would look like progress while skipping the decisive physics

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-compton
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Treating gamma deposits as full-energy photopeaks instead of the Compton continuum expected in a thin 2 mm wafer
forbidden_proxies.reason: In a thin wafer gammas predominantly single-Compton-scatter and escape, so the continuum, not photopeaks, is the physical signal

decisions.summary: Design->parameter mapping locked in code: Ta->Al uses Table II Aluminum column, Al->Hf uses Hafnium column; absorber supplies only Delta_abs.
Hf tau_qp = 400 us adopted (caption/lit) over the 1 ms table cell, flagged MEDIUM.
Ta absorber gap encoded as bulk alpha-Ta BCS assumption 0.68 meV (MEDIUM), film phase flagged for Phase 5.
Saturation ordering fixed as the plateau Gamma_in Hf/Al ratio (3.17x); the 4.75x N_qp-per-eV ratio is the raw yield, not the saturation driver.
Per-design saturation onset energies (~1.27 eV Al / ~0.77 eV Hf) carry the two-exponential peak factor p (0.25 Al / 0.13 Hf); Hf saturates first.
E_rec estimator implemented as an explicit Phase-5 stub (NotImplementedError by default; linear_placeholder=True returns 0.5*E_dep, valid only in the unsaturated regime).
Both censoring variants exposed as a switch at tau_d=40us; the paralyzable-vs-non-paralyzable choice is preserved OPEN as a Phase-5 blocker, not silently chosen.
Huber(235/239/241)+Mueller(238U) coefficients fetched from primary arXiv e-prints with provenance; reconstructed 235U within 0.73%/0.13% of published Huber at 3/5 MeV.
238U(n,gamma) shape from sourced AME2020 Q-values, normalized to 0.6/fission (Kopeikin 2004).

Sub-1.8 MeV fission summation is a flagged seam-anchored non-negative placeholder pending Kopeikin-2012 grounding in 02-02; NOT invented, NOT truncated. Covered by the below-2-MeV uncertainty band (pre-anticipated ROADMAP risk).

Normalization chain R_f=P_th/<E_f>=9.10e19 fissions/s (3 GW_th, effective-thermal <E_f>=205.8 MeV Ma-2013 NOT total Q) x 1/(4 pi d^2) at d=2500 cm applied ONCE; int Phi dE=7.50e12 nu-bar/cm2/s, emission 1.96e20/s/GW_th (Hayes-Vogel ~2e20).

Frozen data/flux/reactor_flux_v1.0.csv with 7-col additive schema, SPLIT band (2-5% >2 MeV -> 20-25% <1.8 MeV, non-uniform), region flags, and version/git-sha/normalization/provenance/integral-check header.

Billard-2017 closure variant (HM constant below 2 MeV, fractions 55.6/32.6/7.1/4.7 isotope-labelled, no 238U<->239Pu swap) emitted as a distinct table (4.59e12) for the Phase-3 Billard Table-1 reproduction.

Sub-1.8 MeV shape kept as a Kopeikin-2012-cited placeholder (no machine-readable Kopeikin table sourceable; none fabricated), covered by the wide low-E band; limitation documented in CSV header, SUMMARY, and ASSUMPTIONS.md.

Per-isotope exact kinematics: E_min^(i)(T)=(T+sqrt(T^2+2 M_i T))/2, T_max^(i)=2E_nu^2/(M_i+2E_nu); PCHIP log-flux interp + adaptive quad fold. sigma(72Ge,4MeV)=1.0026e-40 (0.26% from anchor); closed-form identity to <=6e-8.
dR/dT = 67.8 counts/kg/day above 50 eV_nr at OUR 3 GW_th/25 m config
decisions.rationale: genuine physics (~90x Billard's 0.76 at 8.54 GW/400 m, matching the geometry/power ratio). >20% backtrack trigger NOT met; absolute Billard/CONUS+ comparison deferred to 03-02 via the k~=0.0111 rescale.

decisions.summary: Helm F^2 (Lewin-Smith): 0.9963 at 200 eV, 0.9639 at 2 keV endpoint; turning F off shifts integrated rate 0.38%. CONVENTIONS 'F^2>0.998' = dominant sub-200 eV regime; 0.964 = rare E_nu~8-10 MeV tail. Reconciled to avoid downstream misflag.
Ge isotope abundances = IUPAC/CIAAW representative number fractions (MEDIUM); M_i=A*931.494 MeV; 73Ge axial term ~1/N^2 not modeled (stated assumption).

Derived Billard renormalization k=(P_B/P_v)(d_v/d_B)^2: single-source (8.54 GW/400 m) 0.011120 vs two-core (4.27 GW at 355.39 & 468.76 m) 0.011092, agree 0.25%; k-rescaled Billard integral flux 5.10e10 nu cm^-2 s^-1. Both powers thermal (GW_th), distance squared (fp-gwe-gwth rejected).

Billard 2017 Table 1 reproduced WITH k: 0.7415/0.5009/0.2567 counts/kg/day above 50/100/200 eV_nr vs 0.76/0.51/0.26 (-2.4/-1.8/-1.3%, all <2.5%, well inside ~20%). WITHOUT k the fold overshoots by exactly 1/k=89.9x (66.7/45.0/23.1). 100/200 eV bins <2% so no ROADMAP backtrack. Per-isotope Ge sum (fp-lumped-A-billard rejected).

CONUS+ coarse factor-2 cross-check: flagship (67.75/kg/day >50 eV) and Billard Table 1 both rescaled to CONUS+ config (3.6 GW_th/20.7 m) give 118.6 vs 119.6, ratio 0.99. Two independently-normalized flux models agree at a common config. eV_ee quenching caveat -> coarse scale check only, MEDIUM confidence.

Flux band propagation: rigorous 1-sigma band 3.4% (>=95 eV, matches well-anchored 2-5% high-E flux) rising to 6.2%/9.8% at 50/20 eV_nr; sub-1.8 MeV toggle localizes the placeholder systematic below ~95 eV (E_min(95 eV)~1.78 MeV): sub-1.8 rate fraction 17.8% at 50 eV, 33.8% at 20 eV, ~0 above 95 eV, T>200 eV unchanged <1e-3. The plan's 20-25% guess is corrected (finding, not a bug).

Muon dR/dE_dep folded from Gaisser-Guan flux (P1-P5 verbatim, arXiv:1509.06176) x analytic ray-box chord (Cauchy <ell>=0.385 cm reproduced to 0.03%) x Landau-Vavilov MPV. Integral rate 1.366 +/- 0.005 Hz (deterministic quadrature 1.415 Hz), within ~15% of PDG 1.5-2 Hz (VALD-02). Surface-flux measure I*A_proj*sin(theta) validated by J_horiz=pi*I_v/2 to 0.01%.

Landau-Vavilov MPV computed in code (not memorized): vertical-chord xi=0.0721 MeV (PDG 0.072), Delta_p=1.232 MeV strictly below mean 1.459 MeV. Custom Landau inverse-CDF sampler (mode -0.22278); deposit=Delta_p+xi*(lambda-lambda_mode) so sampled mode=Delta_p; NOT mean, NOT Moyal. kappa=xi/T_max<0.07 for all chords -> Landau/mild-Vavilov. Guards fp-mean-not-mpv.

Long near-horizontal chords importance-sampled (zenith uniform in [0,pi/2] with reweighting) so the deposit tail is resolved to ~197 MeV (66 bins >30 MeV) - the Phase-5 saturation input. Deposits on the unified phonon E_dep scale, NO quenching, no keVee/keVnr (electron recoil, zero Frenkel correction). Guards fp-angular-bias, fp-quenching-muon.

Compton dR/dE_dep built as a Klein-Nishina angle-sampled ELECTRON-recoil continuum (deposit T_e=E_gamma-E_prime, scattered photon escapes the optically-thin 2mm wafer; NO photopeaks) up to each self-validating edge E_edge=2E^2/(m_ec^2+2E). VALD-03 edges reproduced: 40K->1243.4, 208Tl->2381.8, 214Bi->1541.3 keV (max sampled T_e = E_edge per line, exact). No signal above the max edge or at E_gamma=2614.5. Guards fp-full-absorption, fp-electron-not-photon.

Total single-scatter Compton rate 0.268 Hz vs independent flux x sigma_KN x N_e anchor 0.273 Hz (ratio 0.983, within VALD-03 factor 2). Thin-target on the ONE pinned Cauchy mean chord ell_bar=4V/S=0.385 cm: mu*ell_bar=0.117@1MeV / 0.084@2MeV, double-scatter 1.4%; normal-incidence mu*t=0.061 quoted as optically-thin demo only. Same ell_bar in P, double-scatter, and rate. Energy closure to ~1e-5.

Gamma flux table is a DOCUMENTED TUNABLE input, not invented: line energies + DDEP emission probabilities = nuclear data; absolute flux anchored to cited LABChico EPJP2022 measured spectrum (40K 0.036, 208Tl 2614.5 0.0016 cm^-2 s^-1); Th siblings scaled by DDEP intra-chain ratios; U chain via documented Phi_U=Phi_Th assumption (factor-2 band). NIST XCOM Ge mu/rho frozen (4 cited points, log-log interp). Unified phonon scale, no quenching. Guards fp-invented-flux, fp-quenching-compton.

Muon and Compton deposited-energy spectra assembled on the byte-identical shared log E_dep grid (584 bins, 0.01 keV -> 197 MeV; np.array_equal True, max rel dev 0.0; centers = geometric means of shared_energy_grid() edges to 5e-7). Combined table data/combined_dRdEdep.csv (muon+Compton+total) and figs/phase4_deposited_spectra.png emitted; deposited (phonon) energy only, NO E_rec fold. Guards fp-grid-mismatch, fp-reconstructed-not-deposited.

Energy closure per channel: int dR/dE_dep dE = rate_Hz*86400/mass_kg (mass 0.1099 kg). Muon 1.0729e6 vs 1.0737e6 -> ratio 0.99928 (+/-3.6e-3 MC, 0.07% sub-grid-floor shortfall); Compton 2.1105e5 vs 2.1105e5 -> 0.99997; total-spectrum closure 0.9994. Rates parsed from CSV headers (1.3657 / 0.26846 Hz), not hard-coded. First-moment deposited power reported as a physical diagnostic (mean deposit muon 2.33 MeV > 1.46 MeV vertical, Compton 589 keV), explicitly not an independent number.

Pileup stop-condition: R_tot=1.634 Hz (muon 1.366 + Compton 0.268), occupancy R*tau=3.27e-5 (20us/50kHz sample) / 6.54e-5 (40us/25kHz resolving), R/50kHz=3.27e-5; non-paralyzable dead-time 6.5e-5, paralyzable live fraction 0.999935; mean interval 0.612 s ~ 1.5e4 resolving times. Occupancy << 1 -> stop-condition NOT triggered, quiescent reconstruction not precluded. Within-event muon ~197 MeV saturation flagged for Phase 5. Guards fp-pileup-unchecked.
Count-integral estimator adopted (D-estimator): E_rec=C*sum N_obs with a single global per-design C fixed to slope 0.5; plateau IS the modeled saturation.
Event-count mapping locked (Pitfall 1): expected_n_qp = INT Gamma_in dt = K*tau_qp*N_qp/V_tr (0.03x N_qp Al / 0.008x Hf), NOT the trapped count.
Crossover reported as a band: default ~52.9 eV (Ta->Al) / ~32.1 eV (Al->Hf), equal-split anchor ~13.1/7.9 keV, whole-array plateau ~18.6/11.3 keV; Hf first.
Muon-tail E_rec: non_paralyzable plateau ~35 keV (Ta->Al)/~27 keV (Al->Hf); paralyzable rollover ~3.3/~2.6 keV; both >3 orders below the linear line.
Ta gap handled as a binary trapping gate (ratio 3.58>=2, T_c gate 2.5 K); response invariant to Delta_abs in alpha-phase; beta-Ta design-invalidating; no film value fabricated.
Task 3 checkpoint:human-verify self-assessed satisfied pending orchestrator/researcher review (autonomous run); stop-condition does NOT trigger.

R(E_rec|E_dep) built per design x both censoring variants by uniform log-E_dep importance sampling on the Phase-4 grid (584 cols, 10.14 eV->197 MeV, 80/decade); reuses Plan 05-01 response.py (no re-implementation).

Aggregate off-spot ensemble (~10,287 sensors as one multinomial/Poisson draw per realization); on-spot ~pi r^2 sensors individual; per-class mean pinned to analytic censored_count so the response curve = the validated Plan 05-01 estimator.

Feasibility split EC_EMG_MAX=2000: MUST-USE ref-qpd-repo EMG event train where feasible (CEvNS/low-E), deep-saturation registered-count Poisson (EMG train O(1e8) events infeasible; relative spread ~1e-3 there).

Convergence: peak well-populated cell <=~1.8% at N_s=5000, clean 1/sqrt(N_s) scaling; columns normalize to 1; per-cell MC error stored; straddle-bins flagged. Stable crc32 sub-seeding => reproducible across processes.

Muon-end E_rec: non_paralyzable plateau ~34.8 keV (Ta->Al)/~26.9 keV (Al->Hf); paralyzable rollover ~3.3/~2.6 keV; both ~3-4 orders below 0.5*E_dep (fp-no-saturation). Onset ~52.9/32.1 eV, plateau ~18.6/11.3 keV; Hf first.

Time-over-saturation kept as a LABELED SECONDARY (tos_t_over_s), never auto-switched into the baseline (fp-tos-autoswitch); ceiling pile-up labeled an instrument artifact on the figure (fp-ceiling-peak).
Task 3 checkpoint:human-verify self-assessed satisfied pending orchestrator/researcher review (autonomous run); Phase-5 stop-condition does NOT trigger.

**Censoring switch RESOLVED to non-paralyzable project-wide** (CONVENTIONS F closed). User accepted Phase 5 and chose non_paralyzable for the rest of the project after both variants were computed. params.DEFAULT_CENSORING already = "non_paralyzable"; Phase 6 + downstream use it as the single canonical variant. Paralyzable R matrices retained in response_matrix_*.npz as a sensitivity, not a live switch. Operative high-E response = the plateau (~34.8/26.8 keV muon tail).
Fold conserves counts per channel per design: muon/Compton rel <=2.2e-16 (unit-sum R columns), CEvNS rel <=1.3e-16; CEvNS rebin total 9.6e-5 vs trapz, above-50-eV 67.67 vs 67.752 (0.12%).

Reconstructed peaks (non-paralyzable): CEvNS ~42 eV (0.5*E_dep, sub-keV), muon 18.8/15.0 keV, Compton 16.8/13.3 keV (Ta->Al/Al->Hf); muon MeV deposits saturate to tens of keV (fp-deposited-only guarded).
CEvNS 5-10.14 eV low edge retained (7.27 cts/kg/day) via exact E_rec=0.5*E_dep, not dropped (fp-drop-lowE-cevns); only R_non_paralyzable folded (fp-paralyzable-swap).

deliv-fig-spectra rendered: dR/dE_rec vs E_rec (log-log, counts/kg/day/keV), CEvNS/muon/Compton + total, both designs, from the committed 06-01 CSVs; reconstructed axis not deposited (fp-deposited-only); non-paralyzable only, no paralyzable overlay (fp-paralyzable-swap).

Saturation delimited on E_rec axis (fp-no-saturation-mark): onset (E_dep ~52.9/32.1 eV -> E_rec ~23/14 eV) + whole-array plateau (~18.6/11.3 keV E_dep -> ~4.1/2.5 keV E_rec) shaded; muon pile-up marked at 18.8/15.0 keV E_rec, inside the plateau band -> muon shown reconstructed entirely in saturation.

decisions.summary: Started milestone v2.0: QPD at the NUCLEUS Chooz Very-Near-Site with NUCLEUS shielding
decisions.rationale: USER DECISION 2026-07-22. Stop self-projecting surface backgrounds; adopt the measured, published, shielded VNS environment (Abele et al., EPJC 86, 29 (2026), arXiv:2509.03559) and re-fold the target response for Ge. Supersedes v1.1 Phases 8-12; Phase 7 (ENDF n-Ge elastic, 0.0536 kinematics) carried forward. Locked scenario convention moves from 3 GW_th/25 m/7.5e12 to 2x4.25 GW_th at 72/102 m, 2.1e12, 80% duty (signal /3.6). All spectra extended down to 100 meV (retracts the earlier 10 eV floor).

decisions.summary: v2.0 methods survey: invert NUCLEUS deposit spectra for post-shield fluence; CPU-cost claim VERIFIED (scout flag was wrong)
decisions.rationale: Methods scout proposes inverting NUCLEUS's published CaWO4/Al2O3 neutron deposit spectra (their Figs 8-11) through the flat-box kernel to recover the post-shield fluence in situ, rather than propagating through the shield -- two published targets over-determine it, giving a built-in closure test. ORCHESTRATOR CORRECTION: the scout flagged the 'tens-to-hundreds of millions of CPU-hours' figure as unverifiable; it IS in the paper, p.21: 'throughout this work required tens, even hundreds, millions of hours of computing time', plus the statement that variance-reduction techniques will be required. The scout's grep missed it across a line break. Full Geant4 transport stays OUT OF SCOPE. The scout's independent point stands: a 1-D spherical-shell shield-only MC is a far cheaper fallback than NUCLEUS's full building+4pi+sub-keV chain.

decisions.summary: RESOLVED (orchestrator, pre-roadmap): anchor on NUCLEUS Table 5 at 100% duty, NOT the Sect.2 prose; Ge/CaWO4 signal ratio 2.31 same-pipeline
decisions.rationale: Pitfalls scout flagged a blocking 1.27x ambiguity between Table 5 CaWO4 CEvNS (218.2 mcpd -> 356.5 d^-1kg^-1keV^-1 at their stated 6.8 g / 90 eV RoI) and Sect.2 prose (about 280). Rendered-PDF read confirms the CEvNS row has exactly ONE value per column (218.2/60.7/8.4/-), killing the 'two sub-columns lost in text extraction' hypothesis. Arbitrated with our own pipeline: an independent CaWO4 fold (Ca+W+O natural isotopes, VNS flux 2.1e12, Helm FF, per-isotope) gives 407.7 -> 1.14x the table value and 1.46x the prose value. Table 5 at 100% duty is therefore the correct anchor; prose 280 is the 80%-duty value (356.5*0.8=285). Their prose is internally inconsistent: the Al2O3 prose 20 matches its table entry at 100% (20.7), not 80%. Anchoring on prose would flatter our Ge S/B by 27%. SIGNAL-SIDE CLOSURE TEST PASSED at 14%. CORRECTION to an earlier orchestrator claim: compound N^2/A for CaWO4 is 44.2 (not 65.8 = pure W); naive ratio 1.95 vs folded 2.31, so the naive scaling must not be used as the benchmark. Ge 176.8 vs CaWO4 407.7 d^-1kg^-1keV^-1, both same-pipeline.

convention_lock.metric_signature: not_applicable — no relativistic field theory in this detector/rate pipeline
convention_lock.natural_units: internal-only (hbar=c=1) for CEvNS cross section; k_B EXPLICIT (not =1); I/O in eV/keV/MeV, counts/kg/day/keV, s, cm/um; (hbar c)^2 = 3.894e-28 GeV^2 cm^2
convention_lock.renormalization_scheme: tree-level SM (no loops); only scheme-dependent input is sin2thetaW = 0.2387 (low-energy MS-bar)
convention_lock.coordinate_system: Cartesian wafer frame: x,y in-plane 4in x 4in face, z through 2mm thickness; sensors on one z-face
convention_lock.coupling_convention: CEvNS dsigma/dT = (G_F^2 M/4pi) Q_W^2 (1 - M T/2 E_nu^2) F^2(q^2); prefactor /4pi NOT /8pi; Q_W = N-(1-4 sin2thetaW)Z; sin2thetaW=0.2387 (low-E MSbar); 1-4sin2thetaW=0.0452; Helm F, F(0)=1

custom_conventions.energy_scale_chain: single unified phonon scale, NO ionization quenching, for BOTH NR (CEvNS) and ER (muon/Compton): T=E_nr -> E_ph -> E_dep -> E_rec; E_ph=E_dep-E_stored(defects) (few-% NR-only, 0 for muons/Compton); E_rec(low-E)~=0.5*E_dep; FORBIDDEN: keVee/keVnr mixing, Lindhard/ionization quenching
custom_conventions.detector_normalization: Ge 8.29e24 atoms/kg, rho=5.323 g/cm^3, M=72.63 g/mol; wafer 4inx4inx2mm=20.65 cm^3~=110 g, ~10300 sensors 1/mm^2 one face; reactor 3 GW_th (thermal) at 25 m => ~7-8e12 nubar/cm^2/s; adopt 110 g geometry but KEEP per-kg (counts/kg/day) normalization; '1 kg' framing in SUMMARY.md is STALE
custom_conventions.efficiency_mapping: eps~=0.5 deposited-to-signal, imposed forward-model definition, SAME baseline both designs with +/-10-20% design-dependent band; Ta->Al and Al->Hf may split to per-design numbers in Phase 5; paper physical estimate eta_ce~=0.3 is an independent cross-reference, NOT baseline
custom_conventions.bandwidth_censoring: LOCKED resolving time: 25 kHz max resolvable tunneling rate => 40 us (Nyquist from 50 kHz bw); 20 us at 50 kHz sampling itself (state both); paralyzable-vs-non-paralyzable AND merge-vs-drop kept as EXPLICIT CODE SWITCH (not fixed); OPEN QUESTION BLOCKS Phase 5; both variants must be implementable
custom_conventions.cevns_benchmark_target: Phase-3 unit test: FULL Q_W => sigma(Ge,4 MeV)~=1.0e-40 cm^2 (canonical); N-only quick-check ~1.1e-40 cm^2 (1.08e-40, ~20% tol); coefficient sigma~=4.22e-45 N^2 (E_nu/MeV)^2 cm^2; closed form sigma_tot=G_F^2 Q_W^2 E_nu^2/4pi; PITFALLS.md ~1e-42 value is WRONG (100x)
